name: Marrow in the Stockyards
source:
Toronto, 1928. Frostbitten and pious. Decay creeps just beneath the glittering splendour of the age. Work in a slaughterhouse and surrender to the atrophy of conscience, flesh, and reality itself.

[From [url=https://strateaux.itch.io/marrow-in-the-stockyards]itch.io[/url]]
